scope: local finite-subset union-bound closure for already-recorded almost-sure T_ext extension axioms
local_statement: For a fixed finite Gamma subset of T_ext, if each gamma in Gamma has null-limit failure probability in the fixed probability model, then the failure probability of Gamma is bounded by the finite sum of those null-limit terms, and therefore tends to 0.
checked_invariant: each member failure event has probability tending to 0
failure of the conjunction is contained in the finite union of member failure events
finite sum of null-limit terms tends to 0
boundary: This receipt records only the finite local union-bound step. It does not prove a global zero-one law, Fagin theorem, unrestricted finite-model-theory closure, or positive closure for 0-ary relation vocabularies.
